definitions.gloss: floor plan; plan view; plan drawing
definitions.explanation: A drawing that shows a building, room, or site as seen from directly above — with walls, doors, furniture, or other features drawn flat on a two-dimensional plane. Used in architecture, real estate, and interior design.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平面図|へいめんず}。
examples.english: The floor plan of a house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{平面図|へいめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Looking at this floor plan, you can clearly see the layout of the rooms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建築士|けんちくし}→建築士：24974_kenchikushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{平面図|へいめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いた→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The architect drew up the floor plan for the new apartment building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不動産|ふどうさん}→不動産：06726_fudousan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧{平面図|へいめんず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}→掲載：08993_keisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On real-estate websites, a detailed floor plan is posted for each property.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{平面|へいめん}→平面：20096_heimen⟧ (flat surface, plane) and ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing). A {平面図|へいめんず} shows a structure or area from a bird's-eye (top-down) perspective, as if the roof has been removed. It is one of the standard types of architectural drawings, alongside ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧ (elevation) and ⟦{断面図|だんめんず}→断面図：14837_danmenzu⟧ (cross-section).

USAGE:
Frequently seen in real-estate listings, house-plan magazines, and building-construction documents. Also used in geometry classes when depicting flat figures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平面図|へいめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw a floor plan
- {平面図|へいめんず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at a floor plan
- {平面図|へいめんず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to indicate on the floor plan
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧な{平面図|へいめんず}: a detailed floor plan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧: room layout — less technical; refers to the arrangement of rooms rather than the drawing itself
- ⟦{立面図|りつめんず}→立面図：23671_ritsumenzu⟧: elevation drawing — shows the exterior as seen from the front or side
- ⟦{断面図|だんめんず}→断面図：14837_danmenzu⟧: cross-section drawing — shows the interior as if sliced vertically
- ⟦{見取|みと}り{図|ず}→見取り図：14836_mitorizu⟧: sketch map, rough layout drawing — a simpler, less precise version often drawn by hand
